BrochureContent.Content:
Set in the countryside of Donoughmore, Co. Cork, this traditional detached property presents an excellent renovation opportunity. Having been vacant for a number of years, the residence is in need of substantial refurbishment and offers great potential to create a wonderful family home.

The property benefits from numerous outhouses and outbuildings, together with fields to the front and side, providing generous outdoor space and plenty of scope for storage, workshops or other uses, subject to any necessary planning permission.

Given the length of time the property has been vacant, it may be eligible for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant. Due to its current condition and apparent need for significant works to make it habitable, there may also be potential to qualify for the derelict property grant top-up, subject to the relevant criteria and Local Authority approval.

Externally, the bungalow sits on a large, private site, surrounded by mature hedging and open countryside views. The extensive grounds include numerous outbuildings and a large Steeltech shed, offering excellent storage options for vehicles, tools, or equipment ideal for a tradesperson, hobby farmer, or anyone requiring extra workspace.
This property combines the peace and privacy of rural living with the convenience of being within easy reach of local amenities, schools, and transport links. Cork City and Mallow are both easily accessible, making this an ideal location for commuters who wish to enjoy a countryside lifestyle without sacrificing convenience.
With its generous plot, solid structure, and abundant potential, this Donoughmore bungalow is sure to appeal to those seeking a renovation project or a home to extend and enhance over time. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this property has to offer and the exciting possibilities it presents.

Accommodation
Living Room

A spacious traditional living area offering plenty of scope for refurbishment and modernisation. The room features a solid-fuel stove with exposed stone surround, along with fitted overhead storage and good natural light.

The accommodation retains much of its original character and provides a blank canvas for prospective purchasers to redesign and finish to their own taste.

While requiring significant upgrading, the generous proportions offer excellent potential to create a warm and comfortable living space as part of the overall renovation of the property.
 
Bedroom 1

A generously proportioned bedroom offering excellent potential for refurbishment and modernisation. The room benefits from good natural light and provides ample space for bedroom furniture.

Bedroom 2

A well-proportioned front-facing bedroom with natural light provided by a large window overlooking the front of the property. The room offers good floor space and plenty of potential for refurbishment.

Kitchen

The kitchen is located to the rear of the property and features a fitted sink unit with storage beneath and a window providing natural light. The room is in need of complete refurbishment and modernisation, offering purchasers the opportunity to redesign the space to suit their own requirements.

Outbuildings & Yard

A standout feature of the property is the extensive range of traditional outbuildings and outhouses, positioned around a large and private yard area. The buildings include a number of open-fronted sheds and enclosed stores, providing substantial space for storage, workshop use, machinery or other practical purposes.

The generous yard and surrounding grounds offer considerable scope for improvement and could be further enhanced to complement the refurbishment of the main residence. The layout of the existing buildings also provides excellent potential for alternative uses or redevelopment, subject to any necessary planning permission.

 
Features

•Excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a renovation project with significant potential
•Extensive range of traditional outhouses, sheds and outbuildings
•Large yard area providing excellent storage, workshop and amenity potential
•Fields situated to the front and side of the residence
•Attractive rural setting with generous outdoor space
•Potential for extension, conversion or alternative use of outbuildings, subject to planning permission
•May qualify for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant, subject to eligibility and Local Authority approval
•Potential to qualify for the derelict property grant top-up, subject to the relevant criteria and approval
